verdict: Leads surged 37%; Google is spending with zero returns and is being fixed.
narrative: This period you received 155 leads at a cost of $16.99 each — a 30% drop in cost per lead week-over-week driven entirely by Meta performance. At the same time, Google Ads spent $1,039 over 28 days and recorded zero conversions, making it a clear budget leak that is being audited now with conversion tracking corrections targeted for completion by end of September. Weekend days consistently produce zero leads, which is a structural pattern in how your audience engages; Monday through Thursday averages roughly nine leads per day. Next period, expect new paid landing pages and fresh creative to go live by August 31, which should strengthen Meta's efficiency further.
